description: This source file defines the FullTextAspectContentHandler class, which extends ContentHandlerBase to provide full-text content processing based on settings, including display text, body content, and templates, within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: FullTextAspectContentHandler
classes.description: Handles the assembly of full-text content segments for ContentItems, including display text, body, and templates, based on configurable settings.

methods.name: FullTextAspectContentHandler
